tagline: A leading growth investor on a mission to redefine industries and create new exceptional companies
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Asset Value is the key performance indicator for Kinnevik. Reflecting the consolidated value of the portfolio (private and public assets), cash, and net liabilities, NAV demonstrates shareholder value creation and the overall health of the investment fund.

kpis.name: Net Asset Value
kpis.explanation: Total value of Kinnevik's assets after debt, excluding dividends and net liabilities.
kpis.description: NAV is the primary performance indicator for Kinnevik. It incorporates private assets, public assets, cash, and dividends.
kpis.signal: NAV adjusted for SEK 6.4bn extraordinary cash distribution from Tele2 divestiture in June 2024.

kpis.name: Net Cash
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash available after repayment of short-term debt.
kpis.description: Net cash enables Kinnevik to finance new investments without raising capital.
kpis.signal: Strong cash position provides flexibility for new investments following Tele2 divestiture and extraordinary distribution.

kpis.name: Portfolio Concentration in Core Companies
kpis.explanation: Share of portfolio value invested in the 10 largest assets.
kpis.description: The portfolio has become increasingly concentrated on core companies (Spring Health, TravelPerk, Pleo, Cityblock, Mews and others) through strategic reallocation and valuation growth.
kpis.signal: Portfolio concentration to core companies expanded from 29% to 53% during 2024; top 10 assets represent 73% of growth portfolio.

kpis.name: Health & Bio Sector Allocation
kpis.explanation: Share of portfolio value invested in the Health & Bio sector.
kpis.description: Health & Bio is the largest portfolio segment, covering value-based care models, virtual care, and bio. Led by Christian Scherrer, Senior Investment Director.
kpis.signal: Largest portfolio segment; backed by strong IRR of 31% inception.

kpis.name: Software Sector Allocation
kpis.explanation: Share of portfolio value invested in the Software sector.
kpis.description: Software sector targets digital transformation through vertical SaaS and consumerization of enterprise solutions. Led by Akhil Chainwala, Senior Investment Director.
kpis.signal: Second-largest segment with strong IRR of 32% inception; focus on vertical SaaS and consumerization of enterprise.

kpis.name: Climate Sector Allocation
kpis.explanation: Share of portfolio value invested in the Climate sector.
kpis.description: Climate sector builds green supply chains and supports energy transition. Led by Natalie Tydeman, Managing Investment Director.
kpis.signal: Emerging segment focused on green supply chains and energy transition; IRR of 7% inception.

kpis.name: Health & Bio Internal Rate of Return
kpis.explanation: Average annualized performance of Health & Bio investments since launch.
kpis.description: Internal rate of return in the Health & Bio sector reaches 31%, reflecting the quality of value-based care, virtual care, and bio investments.
kpis.signal: Exceptional IRR of 31% demonstrates strong value creation in healthcare investments since inception.

kpis.name: Software Internal Rate of Return
kpis.explanation: Average annualized performance of Software investments since launch.
kpis.description: Internal rate of return in the Software sector reaches 32%, reflecting the quality of vertical SaaS and enterprise software investments.
kpis.signal: Outstanding IRR of 32% in software demonstrates superior returns from vertical SaaS and enterprise software investments.

kpis.name: Investment Sectors
kpis.explanation: Number of strategic areas on which Kinnevik concentrates its investments.
kpis.description: Kinnevik invests solely in three strategic sectors to maximize impact and expertise: Health & Bio, Software, and Climate.
kpis.signal: Strategic focus on three core sectors: Health & Bio, Software, and Climate Tech for maximum expertise and impact.

kpis.name: Core Portfolio Companies
kpis.explanation: Number of significant companies held in the growth portfolio.
kpis.description: Kinnevik holds more than 20 companies in its growth portfolio, with increased concentration on core companies.
kpis.signal: Portfolio of 20+ growth companies with core holdings including Spring Health, TravelPerk, Pleo, Cityblock, and Mews.

kpis.name: Core Companies Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Average revenue growth of the five main companies (Spring Health, TravelPerk, Pleo, Cityblock, Mews) during the year.
kpis.description: The five core companies achieved average revenue growth exceeding 55% in 2024 with significant profitability improvements.
kpis.signal: Exceptional revenue growth of 55%+ average across core holdings demonstrates strong operational performance and market traction.

risks.title: Dependence on Influence Without Direct Control
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in a central position in the report, with strong language on the absence of direct control despite influence. The trend is stable and the category is central to Kinnevik's investment model.

risks.title: Physical Climate Risk on Portfolio
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly modeled in 2023 with clear methodology, precise technical language, upward trend, and high weight in ESG strategy.

risks.title: Growing Pressure on ESG Governance
risks.score_rationale: The risk is repeated across multiple sections, with insistent language on stakeholder expectations. Upward trend, key category for investors.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit in compliance requirements and risk management expectations, with moderate intensity, upward trend, and growing weight in ESG assessments.

risks.title: Talent Attraction and Diversity
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited by multiple stakeholders as critical, strong language on strategic importance, stable trend, high weight for long-term performance.

risks.title: Supplier Compliance with International Standards
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in performance indicators, with factual language, improving trend, but moderate weight due to delegated management.

risks.title: Integration of Climate Risks into Strategy
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the TCFD framework and reporting, strong strategic language, upward trend, high weight in climate commitments.

ai_positioning.summary: No explicit mention of artificial intelligence in the 2024 annual report. Kinnevik does not position AI as a strategic lever or priority investment theme.
evidence: No reference to AI or related technologies in the Board Report, MD&A, or Risks sections.
Target sectors (Health & Bio, Software, Climate) do not emphasize generative AI or machine learning.
No AI-related investments or partnerships mentioned in the 2024 annual report.
